tasks.label: Deploy: upload changed files (FTP)

tasks.label: Deploy: what changed?
tasks.detail: Lists the site files that differ from the live site (no network, no changes).

tasks.label: Deploy: stage for Cyberduck
tasks.detail: Copies only the changed files into deploy/upload/ and opens it in Finder.

tasks.label: Deploy: verify live

tasks.label: Deploy: audit server for non-site files
tasks.detail: Finds repo files that are NOT part of the site but ARE reachable on mcgheelab.com.

tasks.label: Folders: refresh Finder dates
tasks.detail: Raises every folder's Date Modified to its newest file.
